summary: User requests addition of workflow.uuid7() method to generate time-sorted unique identifiers at the workflow level. Observability partners recommend UUID7, and with community upvote, maintainers are committed to adding this helper method.
userImpact: Users need time-sorted unique identifiers for improved observability and tracing at the workflow level.
proposedFix: Add a workflow.uuid7() helper method similar to workflow.uuid4() that wraps workflow.random() to generate UUID7 format identifiers.
workaround: Users can implement their own UUID7 generation using workflow.random() directly, similar to how workflow.uuid4() is currently implemented.
keyQuote: We've heard from an observability partner that they recommend uuid7, and an extra upvote is enough for me, so we'll likely add a helper for this soon.
